blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) awarded FPJ Panday Bayanihan party-List Rep. Brian Poe the Medal of Merit and the Medal of Disaster Relief and Rehabilitation in recognition of his contributions to public service and disaster response. Poe expressed his gratitude to the PCG, emphasizing that the recognition serves as both an honor and a renewed responsibility to continue helping Filipinos, particularly communities affected by disasters and other crises. “I receive these awards with deep gratitude and humility.
